badges.title: Signed Up
badges.description: Verify a wallet and link your X account.
badges.instruction: Verify a wallet and link your X account.

criteria.label: Verify a wallet and link your X account
Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

badges.title: On Discord
badges.description: Link your Discord account to your Squeekchain profile.

criteria.label: Link a Discord account
criteria.detail: Linked from the Accounts card on your profile. One Discord account per member.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Invitooor
badges.description: Invite your first friend to Squeekchain and have them complete signup.
badges.instruction: Have your first invited friend finish wallet and X signup.

criteria.label: 1 friend joins with your invite link
criteria.detail: A friend counts once they verify a wallet and link X. Friends later disqualified stop counting.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Recruitooor
badges.description: Invite five friends with established X accounts who complete signup.
badges.instruction: Have 5 invited friends with established X accounts finish signup.

criteria.label: 5 friends with established X accounts join with your invite link
criteria.detail: Established X account: created at least 1 year ago. Friends with newer X accounts still count toward The Invitooor, but not this badge. Friends later disqualified stop counting.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Ringleader
badges.description: Invite twenty-five friends with established X accounts who complete signup.
badges.instruction: Have 25 invited friends with established X accounts finish signup.

criteria.label: 25 friends with established X accounts join with your invite link
criteria.detail: Established X account: created at least 1 year ago. Friends with newer X accounts still count toward The Invitooor, but not this badge. Friends later disqualified stop counting.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Buildooooor
badges.description: Submit a Squeekchain project and verify your connection to it.
badges.instruction: Submit one project with verified attribution.

criteria.label: Verify 1 project you built for Squeekchain
criteria.detail: Either an IMD project paid from one of your verified wallets, or a GitHub repository you prove you control with a challenge file. Repositories are rechecked daily; removing the file revokes the badge.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Squeekfather
badges.description: Three of the friends you invited each bring in a friend of their own.
badges.instruction: Have 3 invited friends earn The Invitooor.

criteria.label: 3 friends you invited each bring in a friend of their own
criteria.detail: Each of them needs The Invitooor: someone they invited verified a wallet and linked X. Disqualified members stop counting at either step.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.title: The Tester
badges.description: Use a Squeekchain contract from one of your verified wallets.
badges.instruction: Send a transaction to any Squeekchain contract.

criteria.label: Send a transaction to a Squeekchain contract from one of your verified wallets
criteria.detail: Counts direct calls to the Squeekchain contracts we track on Sepolia; calls made through another contract don't count yet. Wallet activity is read on a schedule, so it can take a while to show.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

badges.instruction: Be the first member to complete signup.

criteria.label: Be the first member to verify a wallet and link X
criteria.detail: Places go by when each member reached it and are never reassigned: if a holder is later disqualified, their place stays empty. Team accounts don't take places.

criteria.label: Account in good standing
criteria.detail: Not disqualified for abuse or duplicate accounts. Wallets funded together are reviewed as one person.

criteria.label: Your wallet and X account are linked
criteria.detail: A signature proves the wallet is yours, and your X account is linked through Squeekchain sign-in.

criteria.label: A trophy for your profile
criteria.detail: It shows on your profile but adds no Aura.
